id./param/scenario/cs/b_070_cs_020.pack|cs_: "Faris! Stop this dangerous behavior!
"Don't worry, Father! I'll solve the star's mystery and put Gallopolis at ease!
"Oh, it's you, {var:1}. Thank you again for helping Faris...
"Ah... Aaah! What!? That f-face!
"It's been a while, Sultan. Since the day of the calamity at Dundrasil, the Colloquy of Kings, sixteen years ago.
"L-Lord Robert! I've heard everything! The tale that the Luminary is a devil's child who brings disaster was nonsense!
"We failed to see through King Carnelian's lies and caused the world's collapse. Please forgive us!
"...It's all right. Lift your head.
"It was all Mordegon's doing, possessing King Carnelian. No one else is to blame.
"L-Lord Robert... Thank you...
"More importantly, the star. If it falls, it's irreparable. Do you know anything about it?
"I've had scholars investigate, but we know nothing so far.
"One thing concerns me. My son Faris found what looks like writing carved on the red barrier covering the star.
"A barrier on the star...? And there's writing on it?
"Yes. So the Prince went to the Celestial Sands with scholars to examine the writing.
"Hmm...
"{var:1}, let's go investigate why the Lantern started falling.
"Lord Robert, if you go to the Celestial Sands, please check on my son. I'm worried about Faris.
"Thank you. I'll tell the checkpoint guards to let you pass. Please look after my son!
"I'll tell the checkpoint guards to let you through, so please take care of my son!"
